verdict.rationale: Quo has its own documented REST API with API-key authentication, JSON responses and per-key rate limits. That lets scripts and automations drive the product without the app UI, which is the core of headless operation for a SaaS. There is no CLI, no CI-specific guidance, and probes found no OpenAPI spec, so automation is possible only through custom API integration. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline documentation or examples, a published machine-readable API spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Quo API enables developers to integrate powerful communication features directly into their applications and workflows.
Include your API key in the Authorization header of each request: `Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY`
Each API key may make up to 10 requests per second.
an API your own agent can read and act on
